purpose: Shared test: Claude and Muse run the SAME extraction on the same three schools, then we compare numbers and sources. Informs whether an automatic 'fetch current price when a school is added' feature is reliable.
script: 1. Open the school's official cost-of-attendance page (the start_url, or the school's own .edu page if the start_url has no numbers). Official .edu pages only.
2. Find the MOST RECENT published undergraduate cost of attendance and record its academic year (e.g. 2026-27).

3. Record, for in-state (home-state resident) and out-of-state separately: total cost of attendance, and each line item: tuition, mandatory fees, housing, food, books/supplies, transportation, personal/misc.
4. Record whether the figures are on-campus, off-campus, commuter, or not stated. Do not mix them.
5. Copy numbers EXACTLY as printed. Never estimate, average, or fill a gap. Use null for anything not printed.
6. Record the exact URL you got each number from (source_url) and the date you checked it.

7. Set confidence: high = total and line items printed on the page; medium = total only or one figure inferred by adding printed lines; low = anything else. If a page shows no numbers (navigation only), say so and do not guess.

per_school.name: string
per_school.source_url: string (the exact page the numbers came from)
per_school.notes: string (e.g. regional tuition breaks, page had no numbers)

claude_results_for_comparison_do_not_rea: withheld on purpose so the test is independent; Claude's results are in the project doc claude/school-costs-test-2026-10-14.md
